title: Entschlossene Klarheit / Konstante Bewegung / Universelle Verbindung
slide_intent: Connect each principle to observable choices so a designer can evaluate how a composition communicates.
strategic_value: Specific treatments of space, color, hierarchy and symbols can give DB’s personality repeatable expression.
demonstration: Three alternating image-and-text groups pair clarity with a modular frame, movement with red sleepers and connection with a framed figure.
practical_value: Select visible choices from the principle that matters to the communication task.

content_islands.name: Clarity
content_islands.spec: Pair the dark-and-white frame with hierarchy, space, contrast and short-headline guidance.

content_islands.name: Movement
content_islands.spec: Pair the red sleeper image with variable type, layout, accents and motion guidance.

content_islands.name: Connection
content_islands.spec: Pair the figure and frame with modularity, accessible reading and familiar symbols.

reference_purposes.Intent: Each principle states its intended effect: focus, felt change, or orientation and coherence.
reference_purposes.Application: The visual-implementation lists translate the principles into design choices.
reference_purposes.Expression: The three specimens give the principles distinct visible forms.
